video_title: Ja Morant Media Availability | Oct. 8, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Ja Morant
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant evaluates his first preseason game with the Trail Blazers
quotes.excerpt: definitely could have been better offensively. The guys told me, going back and watching, I was a little passive.
quotes.quote: On a scale of 1 to 10, I would say probably a 6.5. Definitely could have been better offensively. The guys told me, going back and watching, I was a little passive. I just got to be more decisive when I have the ball and know what I want and where I want to go with the ball. I feel like I picked it up, though. Offense wasn't clicking like that on the defensive end, so that's why I gave myself some leeway with my rating.
quotes.social_post: Ja Morant grades his first preseason game with the Trail Blazers a 6.5 out of 10. He admits he was a little passive and needs to be more decisive with the ball as he adjusts to his new team.

quotes.speaker: Ja Morant
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant on adjusting to playing with new teammates in Portland
quotes.excerpt: I got so much guys on the floor that can do, yeah, like I feel like now it's not like Ja going to score 30.
quotes.quote: I can say it's both. It's playing with new guys and then I got so much guys on the floor that can do, yeah, like I feel like now it's not like Ja going to score 30. So I kind of had that pretty much stuck in my head out there playing and that kind of had me in spot time. I didn't like being in. Obviously talking with the coaches last night, today and then with Dame yesterday, they were just telling me to stay aggressive. Obviously when I'm playing like me, it opens up a lot more on the floor for everybody else. So it's just picking and choosing when I go and do that.
quotes.social_post: Ja Morant says he is still adjusting to a new role in Portland where he does not need to score 30 points every night. He says Damian Lillard and the coaching staff are encouraging him to stay aggressive.

quotes.speaker: Ja Morant
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant on the challenge of balancing playmaking and scoring
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I'm a natural point guard. I'm not selfish at all, so that's a definitely a tough part.
quotes.quote: It's tough because I feel like I'm a natural point guard. I'm not selfish at all, so that's a definitely a tough part. Even in that third, Danny like, 'Nah, we about to run it again and you going to drive again.' That's kind of like, I wouldn't say it's new, but it's different, like a different mindset for me knowing that, you know, I like to pass the ball but also can score. Like I said, it's a balance. Definitely different, but something I expect right now. I'm on a new team and this is the first game we played and my first since January, so a lot goes into play of that, but I wouldn't say I'm worried about it at all.
quotes.social_post: Balancing playmaking and scoring is a work in progress for Ja Morant in his first game since January. He says it is a different mindset but he is not worried about the adjustment period.

quotes.speaker: Ja Morant
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant on bringing joy to his new team environment
quotes.excerpt: I feel like it's just the same joy. I just feel like now being around a new team and these guys, they get to see it.
quotes.quote: I feel like it's just the same joy. I just feel like now being around a new team and these guys, they get to see it. Obviously my joy and stuff was in Memphis in previous years, so you had the players there saying it. Obviously my opponents don't get to see too much of that side. So now being around them every day, sitting in the locker rooms, whatever it is, joking and just coming in with energy and stuff, they get to see that. And that's what I try to just bring. That's I feel like that's my personality and bring joy to the gym so make sure we can have a good day each and every day.
quotes.social_post: Ja Morant says he is focused on bringing his personality and energy to the Trail Blazers locker room to help build chemistry with his new teammates.

quotes.speaker: Ja Morant
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant on his impressions of Scoot Henderson's development
quotes.excerpt: Twin, yeah, he ready. He ready for sure. Definitely been opening some eyes and been very impressive since we stepped foot here.
quotes.quote: Twin, yeah, he ready. He ready for sure. Definitely been opening some eyes and been very impressive since we stepped foot here. I just continue to tell him the same thing that they was telling me. Every message that I get passed on, I know he pretty much can get downhill and do the same thing I do on the offensive end. So my job is, you know, if I hear it from me, knowing somebody else can do the same thing, I'm going to tell him the same thing. But he's been handling it great. He's been very poised, patient in the offense and just taking the shots he want and obviously on the defensive end he's definitely been way more aggressive and better for sure.
quotes.social_post: Ja Morant is impressed with Scoot Henderson so far in preseason. He says Henderson has been poised and patient in the offense while showing increased aggression on the defensive end.

quotes.speaker: Ja Morant
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant on the importance of communication with Damian Lillard
quotes.excerpt: We constantly talking, communication. Obviously we've been around, played against each other, so we kind of know each other's tendency.
quotes.quote: We constantly talking, communication. Obviously we've been around, played against each other, so we kind of know each other's tendency. It's just finding those within the offense and what we want to accomplish out there on the floor. I wouldn't say it's been hard, but I won't say we got it down pat yet either. We still got some work to do for sure. I said we definitely better than the rating I gave myself, but we still got some work to do for sure. It's just once it get to clicking though, it'll be real pretty.
quotes.social_post: Ja Morant says he and Damian Lillard are constantly communicating to learn each other's tendencies. He admits they have work to do but believes it will be real pretty once they get clicking.

quotes.speaker: Ja Morant
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant on Damian Lillard's playmaking and floor spacing
quotes.excerpt: With Danny, his ability to be able to get down the floor, get downhill and finish through contact or without contact is extreme plus for us.
quotes.quote: With Danny, his ability to be able to get down the floor, get downhill and finish through contact or without contact is extreme plus for us. And the more we can get him in open space and let him see those gaps, it'd be great for us. So me and Dame's job is to continue to make sure everything in the right place, everybody's in the right spots and their strengths and just let them go be them. I feel like a lot of our turnovers now is coming from everybody being passive because we got so much guys that can do so much on the floor. We just got to be more decisive for sure.
quotes.social_post: Ja Morant says the Trail Blazers are currently dealing with turnovers because players are being too passive. He emphasizes the need for the team to be more decisive with the ball.

quotes.speaker: Ja Morant
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant on the unselfishness of the team's ball handlers
quotes.excerpt: he has tell me to come get the ball when I'll be trying to give him the ball. Like it's that's crazy for me now.
quotes.quote: He's definitely a selfless player. Like even now, like he has tell me to come get the ball when I'll be trying to give him the ball. Like it's that's crazy for me now. Like we both, we all kind of going through the same thing. Like it's like we all trying to make sure everybody get their share of the basketball. But I feel like with our style and the way we play, it'll come along and how y'all seen yesterday with how the floor opened up for Danny yesterday, it's yeah, I feel like each and every game it should be somebody new for sure.
quotes.social_post: Ja Morant notes that the Trail Blazers have a very unselfish group of ball handlers. He says everyone is trying to make sure everyone gets their share of the basketball.
